metrics_coverage.animal_obstacle_fraction: available per run; distinct animals, not run incidence
metrics_coverage.joint_completion: available for all runs including failures
metrics_coverage.predicted_candidate_infeasibility: rs_no_safe_candidate is available; not a physical-unavoidability certificate
metrics_coverage.miss_rate: not validated; empty observation ticks and mean visible count are not false-negative rate with eligible-target denominator
metrics_coverage.warning_lead: partial legacy ttc_lead; not validated as actual delivered-warning lead for every threat event
metrics_coverage.control_compute_time: ctrl_ms covers controller.step only; excludes sensor fusion, feasibility and new RS supervisor
metrics_coverage.wall_time: wall_s recorded per run in a concurrent batch; not a serial per-cycle latency benchmark
